name: Accord
author: vonsensey
description: Omarchy themes your terminal, editor, and shell beautifully. Accord does the rest: GTK4, GTK3, and Qt apps follow your theme - light and dark, live. Fixes the unthemed-Nautilus problem in one enable.

barWidget.description: GTK & Qt apps follow your Omarchy theme. The dot wears the current accent; click for the palette panel.

schema.label: Restart background GTK apps after applying
schema.description: GTK4 apps read the palette only at startup. Accord restarts known windowless app daemons (Nautilus and friends) so they repaint; apps with open windows are never touched.
